dedupe_keys.name: naturescot onshore wind farm proposals in scotland footprints of installed consented in planning and scoping wind farms with renewables wfs and wms

description: NatureScot publishes a map of onshore wind farm proposals in Scotland that shows the approximate area of land occupied by each wind farm, usually from the site boundary in the Environmental Statement or otherwise a turbine envelope from the outer turbine positions, often including access tracks but not grid connections. It covers wind farms that are installed, consented, in planning or at scoping stage on which NatureScot was consulted, generally with turbines taller than 50 m; confidential, withdrawn and refused schemes are excluded. The layer is served through the NatureScot renewables WFS and WMS, which also carry the carbon and peatland 2016 map and its wind farm spatial framework version, a bare peat map from Sentinel-2 and a muirburn peatland map, and it is available for free download as shapefile, file geodatabase, GeoPackage, GeoJSON and GML, with an open data hub page and map viewer. The metadata say it is updated annually; the record date is 8 January 2025. Coverage is Scotland. Caveats: NatureScot states the map is an overview that will never be fully accurate, has gaps and must not be used for detailed assessment; no licence is named in the metadata read. Simulation uses are wind farm locations and pipeline status for regional capacity and grid planning. Related records: data-harmonised-global-wind-solar-farm-locations-osm is a global alternative.
licence: not stated in the metadata read (WFS lists no fees or access constraints)
